description: Open Agile Architecture evidence tools — compliance evidence validation and strategy-canvas completeness checks for OAA sprint work.

tools.name: oaa_check_compliance_evidence
tools.description: Validate a sprint compliance-evidence file (compliance-evidence-sprint-N.yaml) against the OAA compliance-evidence schema. Returns a structured verdict: schema violations (if jsonschema is available), control status rollup (pass/gap/pending counts), scan summary highlights, and next-sprint goals. Use it to check OAA compliance evidence before it feeds a governance report.

evidence.description: The parsed compliance-evidence document (YAML loaded to a dict, or a JSON object). Must contain 'sprint' and 'controls'.

tools.name: oaa_check_strategy_canvas
tools.description: Check an OAA Agile Strategy Canvas document for required-structure completeness: design principles (each with principle/axiom/rationale), transformation waves, and resilience mapping entries. Returns a list of structural gaps, not a verdict — the canvas is a thinking artifact, so completeness matters more than strict schema conformance.
